raw_text: Multiple videos from Rostov showing Wagner fighters on the streets. Civilians are walking around and even taking selfies with PMC troops. The Russian army seems to have offered no resistance so far. Some videos show Wagner air defense systems deployed in the city. The situation is surreal — this looks like an unopposed military takeover.
